name: Dr. Robert Tanaka, MD
reviews: Dr. Tanaka manages my kidney disease with great care and clear explanations.
He caught my declining kidney function early and helped slow it down.
Very knowledgeable about the anemia that comes with kidney problems.
profile_text: Dr. Robert Tanaka is a board-certified nephrologist treating chronic kidney disease, hypertension-related kidney damage, electrolyte disorders, and the anemia of chronic kidney disease. He manages patients whose anemia stems from reduced erythropoietin production due to declining renal function.
guideline_text: Anemia in the context of kidney disease: assess eGFR, creatinine, and urine albumin alongside a CBC and iron studies. Anemia of chronic kidney disease results from impaired erythropoietin production and is managed with erythropoiesis-stimulating agents and iron support. This applies only when reduced kidney function is present; in patients with normal renal function, iron-deficiency anemia should be evaluated by hematology rather than nephrology.
